hook_stat.sub: People Leicester City Council estimated attended Diwali Day on Sunday, November 8

stats.label: Year Leicester's first public Diwali lights went up along Belgrave Road
Revellers travelled from as far as Canada for the celebrations

diaspora_bullets: Among the largest Diwali celebrations outside India, the BBC reported
A major celebration of the city's South Asian heritage
news_summary: Leicester's Diwali Day celebrations on Sunday, November 8, 2026 drew about 30,000 people, Leicester City Council said, as the Golden Mile along Belgrave Road was illuminated and the Wheel of Light returned.
payoff: Described by the BBC as among the largest Diwali celebrations outside India.
